decisions.reason: The source also changes coded-referral commission coverage, but the existing message-595 MODIFY already fully records one commission per non-promotional coded-referral mint.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already records one ticket for every non-promotional no-referral mint while preserving weighted-draw allocation, so no additional change is needed.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already records one commission for every non-promotional no-referral mint while preserving weighted-draw allocation.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already revises the FAQ state to describe one ticket and one commission per non-promotional mint and weighted-draw allocation for referral-free mints.
Changing reward counts and excluding promotional mints does not alter which referral identifiers are valid or the prohibition on self-referrals.
The source changes reward issuance quantities and eligibility, not the NFT token serial used as the permanent referral identity or its display locations.
The About-page state at this time contains only general Small Block ticket and prize descriptions and no conflicting ticket-per-mint or promotional-mint rule that must change.
The number and eligibility of newly issued tickets do not change how active or expired tickets, referral identity, badges, or book access behave after NFT transfer.
The source does not change which metadata fields are visible or their data sources; the Small Block ticket counter remains required regardless of the revised issuance count.
The landing-page state already uses general referral-entry language and contains no current conflicting ticket-per-mint or promotional-mint statement that the source necessarily changes.
Reward issuance quantities and promotional-mint exclusion do not change the email provider, delivery behavior, notification channels, or required email contents.
The source changes how many tickets qualifying mints issue, not which Small Block tickets are eligible for a draw or how they are burned and reset afterward.
